name: Pick
text:
Decision: Focus first on GitHub and Reddit as our primary sources for AI mining, with Product Hunt as a secondary check.

Reason: GitHub gives us raw, unfiltered code and discussions where AI tools are actually built and debated. Reddit hosts deep, technical threads where engineers and researchers hash out pros and cons—perfect for spotting trends early. Product Hunt is great for spotting shiny new launches, but it’s noisy and often lacks the technical depth we need to judge real impact.

Trade-off: We’re accepting that we might miss some niche launches or social chatter by deprioritizing Telegram and HN right now. But GitHub and Reddit give us the highest signal-to-noise ratio for quality insights, so we’ll circle back to the others once we’ve dug into these two.
